title: The Empty Circle
invitation: Mara Venn needs a hand with the signal box. It’s gone dark in the fog.

panels.text: The relay clicks, but it won’t ring. Mara pulls out a brass token someone wedged under the hammer.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: Ivo checks this box on his way home. If it stayed dark, he didn’t come home.
The bent wire has scratched the token. Mara holds her notebook inside her coat to keep it dry. Down the road, someone calls for help.

choices.label: Make a rubbing of the token
choices.reply: Mara cups the page in both hands. The dent comes through beside the circle. ‘I know that stamp. They use it at the ore lift.’
choices.consequence: Keep the rubbing. You can show it to the ore-lift keeper.

choices.label: Fix the signal for the stranded walker
choices.reply: You hold the wire against the contact until the lamp catches. A walker helps a limping Growlithe toward the light. Once they’re clear, Mara looks down at the empty bolt hole. ‘Someone took the bell off.’
choices.consequence: The walker made it off the road. Word of the repair reaches the ore lift.

secret.title: Under the Dent
secret.hint: Keep a record of the token's face and the mark beside its circle.
secret.text: Tilt the rubbing under the lamp. The dent is a punch mark. Someone logged this relay as serviced after silencing its bell. Mara writes down where the token was found.
